breaks: EXACTLY three text lines under the label, each on ONE line; keep the full-width question mark ？
subject: the channel host from the identity refs (the AUTHOR of this analysis series, NOT the creator being analyzed), styled as a confident oil-field engineer: a glossy white hard hat with safety goggles pushed up onto it, an orange fire-resistant work coverall with reflective silver stripes, work gloves. Both gloved hands turn a big red cast-iron valve wheel on a thick steel oil pipeline. Friendly, confident, slightly playful smile with relaxed brows; upper body three-quarter view, eyes to the viewer. Looks fresh and well rested, clean-shaven. Magazine-portrait look, 85mm lens, warm golden sunset key light with a rim light
scene: a Gulf-region desert oil field at golden sunset, densely filled with silver steel oil pipelines at different depths (flanges, elbows, pipe racks), nodding pumpjacks, storage tanks and a refinery with glowing flare stacks; one big pipeline runs across the whole bottom of the frame and connects to the valve he is turning; heat haze and golden bokeh; no readable signs, no flags, no other people
filming: no camera, phone or microphone anywhere — the host is shown as an oil engineer, not filming
prop: none — the oil pipeline and valve are the only props; no arrow

scene_texts.where: in bold black on the front of the white hard hat
in bold black on a white name patch on the left chest of the coverall, one line
as large black industrial stencil lettering painted on the big pipeline along the bottom, left of his hands
